description: This file defines utility functions for handling WiFi-related configurations and path resolutions in a wireless management system, specifically within the beerocks namespace. It provides functions to convert between string representations and internal enums for bandwidth, frequency, security modes, encryption types, and object paths related to WiFi elements like AccessPoints, SSIDs, radios, and endpoints.

classes.name: wbapi_utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static functions for WiFi configuration conversions, path resolutions in the data model, and object attribute retrieval within the beerocks framework.

methods.name: bandwith_from_string
methods.description: Converts a string bandwidth representation to a beerocks::eWiFiBandwidth enum.

methods.name: bandwidth_to_string
methods.description: Converts a beerocks::eWiFiBandwidth enum to its string representation compatible with TR181.

methods.name: band_to_freq
methods.description: Converts a string bandwidth or frequency description to beerocks::eFreqType.

methods.name: band_short_name (string)
methods.description: Provides a short descriptive name ('24g', '5g', '6g') for a given bandwidth string.

methods.name: band_short_name (beerocks::eFreqType)
methods.description: Provides a short descriptive name for a given eFreqType.
